description: Source code for protobuf extensions handling in Go, including extension management, encoding, decoding, and utility functions within the 'proto' package.

classes.name: extensionsBytes
classes.description: Interface representing message extensions with methods for extension range and retrieval.

classes.name: slowExtensionAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for extensions stored as byte slices, with methods to read extensions.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Represents a protobuf extension with encoding, decoding, and comparison methods.

classes.name: sortableMapElem
classes.description: Helper struct for sorting extensions by field number.

classes.name: sortableExtensions
classes.description: Slice of sortableMapElem pointers implementing sort.Interface.

methods.name: extensionsWrite
methods.description: Method to write extensions, panics if unsupported.

methods.name: extensionsRead
methods.description: Method to read extensions from byte slice, panics on error.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Compares two Extension objects for equality.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two Extension objects for ordering.

methods.name: SizeOfInternalExtension
methods.description: Calculates size of extensions for a given extendable proto.

methods.name: StringFromExtensionsMap
methods.description: Returns string representation of extensions map.

methods.name: EncodeExtensionMap
methods.description: Encodes extensions map into byte slice.

methods.name: EncodeExtensionMapBackwards
methods.description: Encodes extensions map into byte slice in reverse order.

methods.name: GetRawExtension
methods.description: Retrieves raw bytes of a specific extension by ID.

methods.name: BytesToExtensionsMap
methods.description: Decodes byte slice into extensions map.

methods.name: NewExtension
methods.description: Creates a new Extension from byte slice.

methods.name: AppendExtension
methods.description: Appends data to an extension within a message.

methods.name: encodeExtension
methods.description: Encodes a protobuf extension value.

methods.name: decodeExtensionFromBytes
methods.description: Decodes extension data from byte slice.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes the Extension into its byte representation.

methods.name: GoString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Extension.

methods.name: SetUnsafeExtension
methods.description: Sets an extension value unsafely by field number.

methods.name: GetUnsafeExtension
methods.description: Retrieves an extension value unsafely by field number.

methods.name: NewUnsafeXXX_InternalExtensions
methods.description: Creates internal extensions map.

methods.name: GetUnsafeExtensionsMap
methods.description: Returns extensions map from an extendable message.

methods.name: deleteExtension
methods.description: Deletes an extension by field number from message extensions.
